card.title: Summary and Note-making — condensing any passage

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: **Summary:** read for gist → underline key ideas → draft (author's main idea first, then 2–4 key supports) → cut modifiers/examples to fit the word limit → verify meaning is unchanged and nothing is copied.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Trick 1: Note-making format: title → indented points → sub-points (a, b) → abbreviations with a key; the visual format itself carries marks.
Trick 2: Keep only ONE idea per point; drop examples, repetitions and statistics — selection is the tested skill.

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **Note grammar:** nominalise verbs for headings ('agricultural expansion'); drop articles/auxiliaries in points; every point under 7 words.  ·  **Full guide:** Full model answers, starting-line banks and exam tips: [/knowledge/writing](/knowledge/writing).

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: **Note-making systems (classified)** | System | Layout | Best for | |---|---|---| | Cornell | Cue column + notes + summary | Lectures, revision | | Outline | I. / A. / 1. hierarchy | Ordered topics | | Mind map | Centre + branches | Brainstorms | | Flow chart | Boxes and arrows | Processes |  ·  **Summary rules** | Rule | Why | Common breach | |---|---|---| | One-third length | Compression test | Copy-heavy | | Own words | Proves understanding | Paraphrase-free | | No new facts | Fidelity | Adding opinions | | Third person | Objectivity | ‘The writer says I...’ |

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Q. Make notes on a passage with a title and three main points. (3 marks) — heading, indented points with sub-points, key to abbreviations.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: ```svg Funnel from passage to one-line gist <svg viewBox="0 0 640 200" font-family="Segoe UI" font-size="13"><rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="200" fill="#ffffff"/><g text-anchor="middle"><rect x="120" y="50" width="400" height="30" rx="6" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8"/><text x="320" y="70" fill="#1d4ed8" font-size="12">full passage</text><rect x="180" y="90" width="280" height="26" rx="6" fill="#fefce8"…

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: **Summary grammar:** four paraphrase moves — synonym swap (threat→danger), word-class change (pollute→pollution), voice change (active↔passive), sentence merge; report verbs frame it ('the passage argues…'). Never add your own opinion.  ·  **Note-making:** TITLE in caps → numbered sub-headings (1, 2, 3 — noun phrases, one per paragraph) → compact key-phrase points (a, b, c) → abbreviations (&, →, e.g.) with an 'Abbreviations used' note.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 3: Summary vs notes: summary is connected prose in your own words; notes are fragments — do not mix the two forms.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: Q. What should be excluded from a summary? (1 mark) — examples, repetition and minor details.

rows.text: **Full guide:** Full model answers, starting-line banks and exam tips: [/knowledge/writing](/knowledge/writing).
